fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://www.matagot.com/en/family-games/81-meeple-circus.html. The Matagot product page identifies Meeple Circus as a multilingual EN/FR/RU base game, matching the English rules record. Reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently saw a circus act starts the first act.
clarifications: For the next act, the player with the lowest score becomes first player; if tied, the youngest tied player starts.
Preparation choices proceed clockwise from the first player; the performance itself is simultaneous.
